# API-Sports

API-Sports provides comprehensive sports data APIs covering over 2,000 competitions with more than 15 years of historical data, offering real-time updates and easy integration for developers.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/api-sports/.

## Actions

- **Get Fixture Lineups** (read-only): Retrieve starting xi and substitutes for a fixture.
- **Get fixture statistics** (read-only): Get statistics for a fixture.
- **Get Fixtures** (read-only): Retrieve football fixtures/matches.
- **Get fixtures events** (read-only): Get events (goals, cards, substitutions, var, etc.) from a fixture.
- **Get Head-to-Head Fixtures** (read-only): Get head-to-head fixtures between two teams.
- **Get In-Play Odds** (read-only): Fetch in-play odds for fixtures in progress.
- **Get Injuries** (read-only): Get injured or suspended players.
- **Get League Seasons** (read-only): Get the list of available seasons for all leagues.
- **Get Leagues** (read-only): Retrieve leagues and cups.
- **Get Odds** (read-only): Fetch pre-match odds.
- **Get Players** (read-only): Get player statistics.
- **Get Players Profiles** (read-only): Get the list of all available players.
- **Get Players Seasons** (read-only): List all available seasons for player statistics.
- **Get Players Teams** (read-only): Get the list of teams and seasons in which a player played during his career.
- **Get Players Top Scorers** (read-only): Get the 20 best players (top scorers) for a league or cup.
- **Get team statistics** (read-only): Get detailed statistics of a team for a given league and season.
- **Get Teams** (read-only): Retrieve available teams.
- **Get Coaches** (read-only): Fetch coaches and their career history.
- **Get Countries** (read-only): Fetch available countries for league queries.
- **Get fixtures players** (read-only): Get player statistics from a fixture.
- **Get Fixtures Rounds** (read-only): Get the rounds for a league or cup.
- **Get Live Odds Bets** (read-only): Fetch all available bet types for in-play odds.
- **Get Odds Bets** (read-only): Get all available pre-match bet types.
- **Get Odds Bookmakers** (read-only): List all available pre-match bookmakers.
- **Get Players Top Assists** (read-only): Get the 20 best players (top assists) for a league or cup.
- **Get Players Top Yellow Cards** (read-only): Get the 20 players with the most yellow cards for a league or cup.
- **Get Predictions** (read-only): Get predictions about a fixture.
- **Get Sidelined** (read-only): Get sidelined information (injuries, suspensions, etc.).
- **Get Timezone** (read-only): Fetch the complete list of available timezones for fixture queries.
- **Get Transfers** (read-only): Get all available transfers for players and teams.
- **Get Trophies** (read-only): Get trophies for a player or coach.
